description: Provision an AWS Athena PreparedStatement via the ACK athena controller. Fields mirror the athena.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 PreparedStatement spec.

description.description: The description of the prepared statement.

name.description:
The name of the prepared statement.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_@:]{1,256}$`

queryStatement.description: The query string for the prepared statement.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

workGroup.description:
The name of the workgroup to which the prepared statement belongs.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,128}$`

title: AWS Athena PreparedStatement
